notes: The phone and the server now measure unusual volume with the same measuring cup: today's trading compared against the last 3 months, exactly as the server's reports do. Before this, some parts of the app compared today against everything saved on your device (up to a year of history), so the phone and the server could rank the very same shares in a different order — and the volume % shown could differ from the server's number for the same share. Volume percentages may shift after this update; that is the two sides finally agreeing, not new data.
